Usage: seek advanced <command> [flags]

Advanced commands (schema, parsers, analyze)

Flags:
  -h, --help       Show context-sensitive help.
      --version    Show version and exit.

Commands:
  advanced schema [flags]
    Show or validate schema

  advanced parsers list
    List all available parser schemas

  advanced analyze <text> [flags]
    Analyze text (tokenize, stem)
